question: The Karve Committee, which was constituted in the year 1955, dealt with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**small scale ****industries.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• **In 1955** Village and Small-Scale Industries Committee likewise called the **Karve Committee**, noticed the chance of utilizing small-scale **businesses for advancing rural development**.
 
• A committee on the village and limited-scope businesses were set up by **Planning Commission (presently NITI AYOG) in 1955**.
 
• So, it is additionally called the Village and Small-Scale Industries Committee or Karve Committee after its head **Dattatreya Gopal Karve**.
 
• It was set up for the development and advancement of **small-scale industries** and **rural development**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Karve Committee is also known as **the village and small-scale industries committee** was set up in **1955**. It was set up to find out the potential of utilizing small-scale industries for promoting rural development.
 
• **Elements of IPR 1956- **The main features of this Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956 were as follows:
 
 
• **​**New Classification of industries
 
• Assistance to the Private Sector
 
• The expanded role of Cottage and Small-Scale Industries.
 
• Balanced Industrial Growth among Various Regions
 
• Development of managerial and Technical Cadres
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** The committee focused on the ‘promotion of small-scale industries for rural development. Small-scale industries are a good source of employment for people.
 
• The Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) 1956 was adopted in order to achieve the aim of a socialist state with the government controlling **the major strategic industries of the economy**.
